title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 28% Cashback on Minimum $200 Spend, Capped at $150 Per Order @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 28% Cashback on Minimum $200 Spend, Capped at $150 Per Order @ ShopBack

[UncleRico] If you’re ordering between $200 and $450, you may only get up to $142 instead of up to $150 cashback. If you’re spending $450 or more, the reduction from 30% to 28% costs you nothing.
Still a great rebate if you were already looking to buy something in their shopfront. Thanks OP! Your mum’s right…
[UncleRico] Interesting promo - wonder how many will see it since its short window overlaps almost perfectly with the NRL grand final?
For any AM4 upgraders looking to get thru the rampocalypse via existing DDR4, it brings the Ryzen 5800x3d down to an ATL of $432 delivered. Or $241 delivered for a 5700x if you don’t need the cache for gaming.
[soulink] Got it. Tracked within 5 minutes full $150
[Tleyx] PS5 digital console $918 minus $150 cashback, seems ok
An I correct on that discount.
PS5 always exempt from discounting usually
[cobknob] Will top cash back match this cap in the coming weeks 🤔
[Captain Hindsight] Still considering tp link deco be65 for around $500, anyone got this recommend?
[A2E2] Orders beyond the 5th one placed on the same day
Does this mean we can get 5 x $150 with 5 orders? Looks like it is different from previous deals, especially the TopCashback ones, where the cap was per member for the whole promotion period.
P.S. This part is still under the Everyday Market terms and conditions:
When a cap is specified, it will apply per member for the length of the promotional period. E.g. $100 cap running alongside an upsized Cashback lasting 3 days, will allow for a maximum pay out of $100 per customer for the 3 day length of the promotion
[xdaybreakerx] DJI Osmo Pocket 3 for $506.99 - CB, or Creator Combo for $663.99 - CB are probably ATL
[chinaman] Motorola Edge 70 8GB/256GB about $448 after cashback for those interested.
Beats yesterday's deal.
[Kai4039] Does anyone know when claim TRS for everyday market, we use the seller ABN or woolworth's ABN ? thanks
[Quarter Pounder] was wondering the same question, as the invoice shows the abn for everyday market and the seller. i think i will use the seller ABN for TRS.
[Kai4039] yeah that would make sense but it would be nice to use woolworth's one cause different seller doesnt add up to $300 separately .
[UncleRico] Promo extended until midnight. Ignore the expired tag.
[prankster] whoops was thinking i could use this for woolies lol
